answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-backed random auditing. Each agent locks a bond and keeps a signed work relic proving genuine past tasks. A verifier samples agents at random, sweeping a dune for footprints, and demands that relic on the spot; failure slashes the bond. To win, an attacker must fund a separate bond and build a real activity trail, an ember kept alive, for every fake identity. Cost therefore grows linearly with the number of Sybils, while an honest agent risks only one stake.
